title: Card updated
description: This event occurs when a card's information or status changes. Endpoints that generate this event include Update card information, Activate physical card, Update card status, Reissue card, Renew card validity, and Delete card validity period. For more information, see the Card lifecycle and statuses guide.

card_hash.title: Hashed PAN
card_hash.description: Hashed PAN. Field exists when the PCI data is created.

card_last_four_numbers.title: Last 4 PAN numbers
card_last_four_numbers.description: Last 4 Primary Account Number (PAN) numbers. Field exists when PCI data is created.

card_printed_name.title: Cardholder's name printed on card
card_printed_name.description: Card printed name. Physical (plastic or metal) cards only.

contactless_enabled.title: Contactless card flag
contactless_enabled.description: Can card make transactions using contactless entry mode? Default is `true`

embossed.title: Embosser file
embossed.description: Name of file containing cards to be embossed sent to embosser.

operation_type.title: Operation responsible for changing card status. For more information, see the `operation` field returned from the List card status history endpoint

abu_enabled.title: Automatic Billing Update (ABU) flag
abu_enabled.description: Must card number be sent to the Mastercard Automatic Billing Updater service. Default is `true`. Mastercard only.

bulk_id.title: Bulk/batch ID
bulk_id.description: Not null if card was created in a noname bulk/batch

card_bin.title: Card BIN
card_bin.description: Card Bank Identification Number (BIN). A 6 or 8 digit value.

cvv_next_rotation_date.title: Next CVV rotation datetime.
cvv_next_rotation_date.description: Scheduled datetime (RFC3339 format), to change the CVV2/CVC2 value. `VIRTUAL` cards only.

cvv_rotation_type.title: CVV rotation method
cvv_rotation_type.description: CVV/CVC2 value rotation method. `VIRTUAL` cards only.

dual_message_debit.title: Dual message debit card flag
dual_message_debit.description: Is card a dual message debit card? Default is `false`

embossing_custom_fields.title: Personalized information sent with embossing
embossing_custom_fields.description: Any customer-provided information for embosser such as tracking number or embossing instructions
examples: Cards should be metal, not plastic

external_id.title: Customer created ID
external_id.description: Customer created ID for externally tracking card

metadata.title: Customer metadata.
metadata.description: Customer provided information. No business rule validation is done.

reissued_card_block.title: Information to replace the card in the automatic billing update flow
reissued_card_block.description: Indicates if the card number is a replacement account to Mastercard Automatic Billing Updater service. Available only for Mastercard in Reissue Card Flow

reissued_card_id.title: Original card ID
reissued_card_id.description: Original card ID. Not null if card reissued

new_card_id.title: New reissued card ID
new_card_id.description: New reissued card ID. Not null if card reissued

update_tokens.title: Update card tokens
update_tokens.description: Should previous card's tokens be migrated to reissued card? Available only for vts (Visa) and mdes (Mastercard) tokenization programs

template_id.title: Template ID
template_id.description: Template ID - Not null if card creation based on template. Templates are used to implement the BIN override feature. For more information, see the BIN override documentation in the Cards overview guide. To create a template, you need to open a Pismo Service Desk request. The ticket type should be **Settings**.

password_tries.title: Password tries
password_tries.description: How many times password was tried.

validity_period_hours.title: Card validity period in hours
validity_period_hours.description: How long, in hours, the card is valid. Used to calculate `valid_until` for `PLASTIC` and `VIRTUAL` cards.

valid_until.title: Card valid until datetime.
valid_until.description: Datetime (RFC3339 format) when the card is no longer valid. Calculated using `validity_period_hours`. When exceeded, the card's status becomes `INOPERATIVE`.

activation_date.title: Card activation datetime
activation_date.description: Datetime (RFC3339 format) when the card was first activated. Only set after card activation.

expiration_date_renewal_data.title: Card expiration date renewal data.
expiration_date_renewal_data.description: Provides information for expiration date renewal.

new_expiration_date.title: New card expiration date
new_expiration_date.description: New card expiration date - YYMM format.

expiration_date_update_status.title: Expiration date renewal status
expiration_date_update_status.description: Specifies the status of expiration date renewal. WAITING means the new expiration date is waiting to be applied. APPLIED means the expiration date has already been updated to the new value.

renewal_request_date.title: Renewal request datetime
renewal_request_date.description: Datetime (RFC3339 format) when the expiration date renewal was requested.

renewal_applied_date.title: Renewal applied datetime
renewal_applied_date.description: Datetime (RFC3339 format) when the new expiration date was applied.
